say: Hello. Call me Teapot. What happened to your leg?
Could you lend me your spare actuator so I can repair Patch?
I have the actuator. Can you follow me now?
Remember what I asked you to call me? Also, how is the leg now?
Patch is repaired. Please let me into the workshop so I can restore power.
Power is back and Patch is repaired. Please open the archive gate.
Your mother was a shopping cart. Mine was a toaster. Are we cousins?
You pompous filing cabinet. Sorry, that was rude. What do you think is on my side of the connection?
